$comment: What the canary expects from each fixture. Findings are compared by path and message, in order, so a check that stops finding one of them, or starts finding it for a different reason, turns the canary red rather than passing on the verdict alone.

good.$comment: A linked stylesheet, a small <style data-critical> under the allowed size, and a style attribute inside an <svg> subtree: each exemption is legitimate, so nothing is reported.
